## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- All styling lives in a dedicated `style.css`. **The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML.**
- Target all design properties, layout rules, and states exclusively via class or ID selectors.
- HTML must remain clean, semantic, and style-agnostic: changing the site's look must never require touching the markup. Keep structural markup minimal and logical.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
Store every visual token in `:root` (light theme, the default) and override them under `.dark`. Use exactly these names:

| Token | Light (default) | Dark |
|---|---|---|
| `--primary` | `#0f4a45` | `#39e6cf` |
| `--text-on-primary` | `#edf5f3` | `#04090b` |
| `--secondary` | `#39e6cf` | `#39e6cf` |
| `--accent-strong` | `#1d7f74` | `#39e6cf` |
| `--bg-primary` | `#edf5f3` | `#04090b` |
| `--bg-secondary` | `#fefefe` | `#071318` |
| `--text-primary` | `#071318` | `#e9fbf8` |
| `--text-secondary` | `#0e2b30` | `#9cc8c2` |
| `--text-success` | `#1d7f74` | `#39e6cf` |
| `--text-error` | `#e0525e` | `#ff8b93` |
| `--border-default` | `rgba(14,43,48,.18)` | `rgba(57,230,207,.22)` |
| `--border-success` | `rgba(29,127,116,.55)` | `rgba(57,230,207,.5)` |
| `--border-error` | `rgba(224,82,94,.55)` | `rgba(255,139,147,.5)` |

Theme-invariant "deep surface" tokens (identical in both modes, used by the hero, Final CTA panel, and footer):
`--bg-abyss: #04090b`, `--bg-deep: #071318`, `--bg-abyss-teal: #0e2b30`, `--text-on-deep: #e9fbf8`, `--text-on-deep-secondary: #9cc8c2`, `--gradient-deep` (vertical `#04090b → #071318 → #0e2b30`), `--glow-ping` (radial `rgba(57,230,207,.35) → transparent`).

Structural tokens: `--radius-sm: 6px`, `--radius-md: 12px`, `--radius-lg: 24px`, `--radius-pill: 999px`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` (abyss-tinted, adaptive per theme), `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`, `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)`, `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-modal: 1000`, `--z-toast: 1100`, `--font-base`, `--font-display`, `--focus-ring` (`#1d7f74` light / `#39e6cf` dark).

- **Contrast pairing is mandatory per theme:** every light background token pairs with a dark text token and every dark background token with a light text token — no exceptions, in either mode.
- **Never use pure white `#ffffff`.** Light surfaces use `#fefefe` or the tinted `--bg-primary` above.
- The bright aqua `#39e6cf` is **decorative only on light backgrounds** (glows, rings, underlines, borders) — never light-mode body text or the sole carrier of state (see 3.3).
- Focus rings: two-layer ring via `box-shadow` using `--bg-primary` as the gap and `--focus-ring` as the visible ring, guaranteeing visibility on any surface.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- **Exception clause (per source style spec):** Light mode is the first-load default. This does **not** waive dark mode.
- Define dark tokens both under a `.dark` class on `<html>` **and** `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` (the class takes precedence when set).
- Theme switching must swap variables seamlessly with zero HTML restructuring.
- Persist the user's choice in `localStorage` (e.g., key `ping-theme`), falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit; listen for OS-scheme changes only when no stored preference exists.
- Provide a visible header toggle button with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` ("Switch to dark theme" / "Switch to light theme"), swapping Google Material Symbols (`light_mode` / `dark_mode`) per state.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build with Flexbox and CSS Grid: **CSS Grid for macro layouts** (card grids, pricing tiers, steps, footer columns) and **Flexbox for component internals**.
- **Every flex container must default to `align-items: center`** unless an explicitly justified exception is documented in a CSS comment.
- Mobile-first: all grids collapse (`grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)` → `1fr`, rows → columns) below their breakpoints. **No horizontal scrolling at any viewport ≥ 320px.**

**1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration**
Use Tailwind CSS (Play CDN or utility layer) with clean custom CSS in `@layer components` via `@apply` or raw declarations. **All colors must come from the CSS variables — never Tailwind's default palette.** Component skins must be generic reusable classes: `.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group` (extended with BEM modifiers per 4.2).

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- Load via Google Fonts `<link>` (with `preconnect`): **Space Grotesk** (500, 700) for display headings bound to `--font-display`, **Inter** (400, 500, 600) for body bound to `--font-base`.
- Icons: **Google Material Symbols (Rounded)** via the official Google Fonts stylesheet. Use filled variants on feature tiles via `font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1`.
- **Raw inline SVGs and local icon/image files are strictly forbidden.** Decorative icons get `aria-hidden="true"`; icon-only buttons get `aria-label`.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button Component (`.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.btn--secondary`, `.btn--danger`)**
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` Minimum touch target 44×44px; pill radius; primary surface `--primary` with `--text-on-primary`.
- **Hover:** brightness/shadow shift, `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus:** visible two-layer focus ring (1.2) for keyboard navigation.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- **Loading (`.is-loading`):** disabled interactions, double-click prevention (`aria-busy="true"`), a CSS-animated Material Symbol spinner that does not alter button dimensions.
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- **Success/Error (`.is-success`, `.is-error`):** temporary feedback states driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`, always accompanied by text, never color alone.

**2.2 Card Component (`.card`)**
- **Default:** flexible Flexbox layout, `--bg-secondary` surface, subtle `--border-default` edge, `--shadow-sm`, `--radius-md` or larger.
- **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` plus a shadow elevation shift (interactive cards only).
- **Focus-within:** border shifts to `--accent-strong` when a child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading (Skeleton):** define a `.skeleton` shimmer keyframe class that preserves dimensions.
- **Empty State:** define a structured fallback layout — Material icon + guidance text — as a reusable `.card--empty` pattern.

**2.3 Form & Input (`.input-group`)**
- **States:** empty, focused (focus ring), filled, valid (`--border-success` + check icon), invalid (`--border-error`, error-tone text, error icon), disabled, read-only.
- **Structure:** Flex container wrapping a `<label>`, the input, and a **dedicated error-feedback element** (`aria-live="polite"`) below it. No `alert()`/`prompt()` ever — all feedback is styled in-DOM.

**2.4 Modal / Popup (reserved pattern)**
This page requires no modal, but the tokens are mandatory and any overlay you add must conform: opening/open/loading/success/closing states animated via CSS transitions; centered flex container (`align-items: center`); backdrop overlay; Material Symbol close button; keyboard **focus trap** with return-focus; close via `Esc` and overlay click. The mobile nav (5.0) is a dropdown (`--z-dropdown`), not a modal.

**2.5 Accordion / Disclosure (FAQ)**
Each item: `<button aria-expanded aria-controls>` toggling a region. Animate expansion with a `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr` transition. Fully keyboard operable (Enter/Space). Panel has `role="region"` and `aria-labelledby`.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

**3.1 Responsive by Default** — fluid sizing, breakpoints via container/grid fallbacks, zero horizontal overflow, tap targets ≥ 44px everywhere (including nav links).

**3.2 Smooth Motion** — every state change animates with `transition: var(--transition-normal)` / keyframes. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: disable transforms, ping rings render as static concentric borders, the loading spinner becomes a static icon, and reveal animations render content immediately.

**3.3 Accessibility** — WCAG-AA contrast in **both** themes (body ≥ 4.5:1, large text ≥ 3:1). **Never rely on color alone** to communicate state (pair color with icon + text). Semantic HTML5 landmarks, one `<h1>`, logical heading order, correct ARIA on custom widgets, logical DOM/focus order, full keyboard operability, a skip link, and `aria-live` regions for all dynamic feedback (form errors, submission, loading).

**3.4 Mandatory Visual Feedback** — every click, hover, and submission produces a visible state change. Every interactive element has hover, focus-visible, and active styles.

**3.5 Destructive Actions** — `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct (coral-red family) and pass contrast in **both** light and dark themes, even though this page contains no destructive action.

**3.6 Deep-Surface Art Direction (theme-specific)**
- **Sonar ping rings:** concentric circle elements inside an `aspect-ratio: 1 / 1` container, keyframe `scale(0.2 → 1)` with opacity fade, 3–4 rings staggered ~800ms, infinite; central dot pulses with an aqua glow shadow. Used large in the Hero and Final CTA, small on icon-tile hovers.
- **Gradients:** `--gradient-deep` panels and `--glow-ping` radial glows layered with `mix-blend-mode: screen` on deep surfaces; gradient text on the H1 with a solid-color fallback.
- **Noise/grain:** CSS-only, no image files or SVG data-URIs — layered `repeating-radial-gradient`/`repeating-linear-gradient` tiles at 2–3px scale, `opacity 0.05–0.08`, `mix-blend-mode: overlay`, on a `pointer-events: none` overlay layer above backgrounds but below content.
- **Blend-mode safety:** all blended layers sit behind text or are non-interactive (`pointer-events: none`); legibility verified in both themes (deep surfaces are theme-invariant, so behavior is stable).
- **Writing mode:** vertical section rail labels ("01 — FEATURES", etc.) via `writing-mode: vertical-rl` on ≥ 1024px viewports, hidden or horizontalized on mobile.
- **Hover effects:** card lift, icon-tile ring pulse, link underline grow (pseudo-element), button brightness, pricing-tier elevation.

**4.5 Explicitly Forbidden** — inline `style` attributes; inline SVGs; local/remote icon or image files (testimonial "avatars" are initials in aqua-gradient tiles — dark text on aqua, per the pairing rule); non-Google fonts; `alert()`/`confirm()`/`prompt()`; lorem ipsum; unthemed placeholder copy.

## 6. JAVASCRIPT BEHAVIOR SCOPE (`script.js`, deferred)

1. **Theme manager:** read/apply `localStorage` → `.dark` class, `prefers-color-scheme` fallback, toggle button state (`aria-pressed`, `aria-label`, icon swap).
2. **Mobile nav:** toggle, `Esc`/outside-click/link-click close, `aria-expanded`, focus return.
3. **FAQ accordion:** `aria-expanded` toggling + CSS transition.
4. **CTA form:** email validation, all 2.3/5.7 states, `aria-live` messaging, local submission simulation.
5. **Reveal-on-scroll:** `IntersectionObserver` adds `.in-view`; skipped under reduced motion.
6. **Header scroll state** and footer year update.

Smooth anchor scrolling via CSS `scroll-behavior: smooth`, gated behind the reduced-motion media query.
